globaldeetsTraffic.note: This is operational telemetry from the latest comparable edge snapshot, not a certified audience refresh.

investmentThesis.label: Product
investmentThesis.title: A governed world-information layer is already live
investmentThesis.statement: GlobalDeets operates as a source-first world desk with live news, place context, public knowledge, webcams, and an evidence-governance layer.
investmentThesis.proof: Current product surfaces + governed source registry + Coverage & Evidence Observatory.

investmentThesis.label: Platform
investmentThesis.title: The estate is visible as an operating system, not a logo wall
investmentThesis.statement: Every web property in the estate is registered with its purpose and owner-declared status, probed on a schedule from more than one network, and judged by an explicit health contract that never treats a reachable page as a healthy one.
investmentThesis.proof: Estate-health contract + scheduled multi-vantage production probes.

investmentThesis.label: Discipline
investmentThesis.title: What is known and what is not are both first-class
investmentThesis.statement: Audience, business outcomes and browser telemetry each carry a state (measured, not connected, awaiting authorization, unavailable). Unknown is never shown as zero, and edge requests are never presented as people.
investmentThesis.proof: Governed audience, business-event and instrumentation contracts.
